maddeler.e:
أنحجب (form VII)
# أَنْحَجِبُ (ʔanḥajibu) /ʔan.ħa.d͡ʒi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# أَنْحَجِبَ (ʔanḥajiba) /ʔan.ħa.d͡ʒi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# أَنْحَجِبْ (ʔanḥajib) /ʔan.ħa.d͡ʒib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
